encoding: checksums[i] = state_checksum AFTER tick i completes, as 16-digit lowercase hex u64. inputs is SPARSE: it lists only ticks whose input was not Noop; every unlisted tick in 0..#checksums is Noop. code = kind*256 + slot, kind in {0:Noop, 1:BuyOffer, 2:Reroll, 3:Clear} (the ids::Input declaration order), slot is 0 except for BuyOffer. player_id is 0 for every trace. No floats appear anywhere in this file.
